 get involved Get Involved published at 19:13 GMT 19:13 GMT 
 Click 'Get Involved' on this page to have your say 
 As a non Palace fan, it’s harsh that Parish isn’t getting more flak after selling the 4 best players without replacing them. However, Sage is not suited to Palace and vice versa. They need to replace him asap. Sir Gareth needs to revisit the Palace!!
 Graham 
 13 20 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 Post published at 19:13 GMT 19:13 GMT 
 Crystal Palace 0-1 Hoffenheim 
 Palace need to be careful here, Hoffenheim know the hosts are only one foul away from someone being sent off and they are playing on it.
 It's a silly foul from Yeremy Pino but it's not a second yellow but Hofffenheim ask the question anyway.
 2 7 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 'It was a brilliant bit of play!' published at 19:11 GMT 19:11 GMT 
 Crystal Palace 0-1 Hoffenheim 
 Glenn Hoddle 
Former England and Tottenham manager on TNT Sports 
 It was a brilliant bit of play. Wharton does fabulous - he acts like he's going to hit it on his right foot, drags it back, and Pino, wow, the goalkeeper does his job coming out quickly to make the save with his left arm.
 25 9 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 'Huge chance' published at 19:11 GMT 19:11 GMT 
 Sparta Prague 1-1 Bournemouth 
 Joe Partington 
Former Bournemouth defender on BBC Radio Solent 
 Huge chance. James Hill tries to be so inventive with a back heel which deflects off a defender.
 Some good pressure from Bournemouth.
 44 4 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 Post published at 19:11 GMT 19:11 GMT 
 Crystal Palace 0-1 Hoffenheim 
 A big chance for a Palace equaliser as Adam Wharton holds the ball up and manages to find Yeremy Pino.
 The Spaniard tries to beat the keeper at his near post from a tight angle but it's a good save from Oliver Baumann.
 15 8 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 Post published at 19:10 GMT 19:10 GMT 
 Sparta Prague 1-1 Bournemouth 
 Chances for the Cherries. The keeper saves David Brooks' effort and James Hill's backheel is blocked.
 12 3 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 YELLOW CARD published at 19:09 GMT 19:09 GMT 
 Crystal Palace 0-1 Hoffenheim 
 Oh and another one. Eddie Nketiah into the book for a foul on Mats Rots.
 Discipline needs to be a bit better.
 16 28 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 'You can't try drag backs in your own area' published at 19:08 GMT 19:08 GMT 
 Crystal Palace 0-1 Hoffenheim 
 Glenn Hoddle 
Former England and Tottenham manager on TNT Sports 
 This is really poor defending from Palace. You can't try drag backs in your own area. Clear the ball!
 It's just another opportunity for Hoffenheim. 
 29 18 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 Post published at 19:08 GMT 19:08 GMT 
 Sparta Prague 1-1 Bournemouth 
 Sparta's Ebrima Singhateh almost wriggles free in the box to shoot but he's tackled by Bafode Diakite, who didn't seem to know loads about it.
 9 0 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 Post published at 19:07 GMT 19:07 GMT 
 Crystal Palace 0-1 Hoffenheim 
 Poor defending again as Honest Ahanor tries a bit of skill in his own penalty box rather than just booting the ball clear and Hoffenheim almost capitalise on what would have been a gift.

 Crystal Palace 0-1 Hoffenheim 
 Frustrations starting to bubble over for the hosts as Yeremy Pino is the latest to have his name taken for a daft challenge.
 1 25 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 get involved Get Involved published at 19:04 GMT 19:04 GMT 
 Click 'Get Involved' on this page to have your say 
 Crystal Palace need a big second half otherwise Sage has to go. We look slow and far too much sideways passing for my liking.
 Glen 
 Image source, Getty Images 
 59 25 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 YELLOW CARD published at 19:03 GMT 19:03 GMT 
 Crystal Palace 0-1 Hoffenheim 
 Honest Ahanor is a bit late on Natnael Abraha and he goes into the book for his challenge.
 9 26 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 'Super sub Adams' published at 19:03 GMT 19:03 GMT 
 Sparta Prague 1-1 Bournemouth 
 Joe Partington 
Former Bournemouth defender on BBC Radio Solent 
 Super sub Tyler Adams. Bournemouth have been given a gift by Sparta Prague again as they try and play it out from the back.
 Adams sniffs out the danger and he sweeps it in that bottom left-hand corner.
 He doesn't celebrate. Bournemouth want more out of this game
 Image source, EPA 
 81 5 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 Post published at 19:03 GMT 19:03 GMT 
 Sparta Prague 1-1 Bournemouth 
 Bournemouth have scored three goals via substitutes in the Europa League this season. No team has more.
 53 0 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 'We will see what happens with two up top' published at 19:03 GMT 19:03 GMT 
 Crystal Palace 0-1 Hoffenheim 
 Glenn Hoddle 
Former England and Tottenham manager on TNT Sports 
 In some ways it's a shame Kamada dropping deep to support Wharton because Kamada was the one who was getting in and looking dangerous, particularly in the first half.
 But Nketiah coming on to join up with Mateta up top, we will see what happens with two up top.
 38 4 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 YELLOW CARD published at 19:02 GMT 19:02 GMT 
 Crystal Palace 0-1 Hoffenheim 
 Woah. Tensions spilling over as Yeremy Pino is fouled then Adam Wharton mistimes his challenge on Wouter Burger before Pino goes for a little nibble on Leon Avdullahu and he gets a shove back in return.
 Everyone gets a talking to but only Wharton ends up in the referee's book.
